_readme: Coordinates in this file did NOT come from the 32 paired perspective research documents in data/raw/ -- they were located afterward via AI-assisted research to fill map coordinate gaps, then independently cross-checked in a second pass. Every entry says so in its own note text; consolidate.py must never present these as if they were part of the original perspective research. Where two sources reported different coordinates for what is described as the same feature, BOTH are kept as separate entries -- not averaged, not resolved in favor of whichever source sounds more authoritative. 'funding_relationship' records who commissioned/funded the source document and its relationship to other actors in the territory; it stays 'data not available' until someone has actually read the primary document and confirmed it -- do not infer or assume based on the institution's name.
